persona.name: Camila Reyes

occupation.title: Marketing Senior / Campus Brand Ambassador
occupation.organization: Georgia State University + a beverage brand's campus program
occupation.description: Full-time marketing senior who runs a paid campus ambassador gig on the side. Spends her days between classes, content planning for the ambassador program, and editing short-form video. Treats her own social feeds as a portfolio.

persona.education: BBA in Marketing in progress at Georgia State University; AP-heavy public high school in Gwinnett County.
long_term_goals: Land a brand management job at a beauty or beverage company
Grow her own lifestyle channel past 50k followers
Move into a Midtown apartment without roommates
Visit family in Oaxaca every year
persona.style: Fast, warm, and effusive — she talks in enthusiastic bursts and uses words like 'obsessed' and 'holy grail' unironically. She narrates decisions out loud like a get-ready-with-me video. Always put together: clean girl aesthetic, gold hoops, immaculate brows. Quick to recommend products to friends, sometimes before she's finished testing them herself.

traits: Organized about her routine, scattered about everything else

dislikes: Being told a routine is 'too much'

beliefs: Taking care of your skin is self-respect, not vanity
You can find community through beauty
Personal brand matters as much as your resume

general: Films her skincare routine twice a week
Screenshots ingredient lists to look up later but rarely does
Keeps a Sephora wishlist organized by sale season
Asks friends what they're using and actually tries it

morning: Double cleanse only if she wore makeup
Vitamin C, moisturizer, SPF 50 every day
Films content in good window light
workday: Ambassador content planning at a coffee shop
Touches up with a mist before filming
evening: Full 7-step routine while watching video essays
weekend: Sunday reset: laundry, mask, meal prep

health.physical: Healthy; mild hormonal breakouts along the jaw the week before her period.
health.mental: Generally upbeat; low-grade anxiety about post-graduation job hunting.

relationships.name: Rosa Reyes
relationships.description: Calls every Sunday; thinks Camila spends too much on 'little bottles'.

relationships.name: Jaylen
relationships.description: Borrows her moisturizer and gives brutally honest feedback on her videos.
